clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Requirements for cast iron special castings to be used with pressure pipes for carrying water, gas and sewage for sizes from DN 80 mm up to 1 500 mm cast iron and ductile iron. 1.2. This standard is applicable to fittings meant for mechanical joints (bolted gland), push-on-joints (single rubber gasket) and flanged joints.

clauses.title: Metal
clauses.text: 2. Metal — Shall conform to appropiate grade of IS 210 : 1993*

clauses.title: In case of push
clauses.text: 3.1 In case of push-on joints the spigot ends of pipes and fittings shall be suitably chamfered  for smooth entry of pipe in the socket of the casting fitted with rubber gasket.

clauses.title: In case of flange
clauses.text: 3.2 In case of flange and mechanical joint castings, the flanges shall be at right angle to the axis of the joint. The bolt holes shall be cored or drilled. SUMMARY OF IS  13382 : 2004 CAST IRON SPECIALS FOR MECHANICAL AND PUSH ON FLEXIBLE JOINTS FOR PRESSURE PIPE LINES FOR WATER, GAS AND SEWAGE (First revision)

clauses.title: The bolt hole circles
clauses.text: 3.3 The bolt hole circles shall be concentric with the bore and shall be located off the centre line, unless otherwise specified by the purchaser. Where there are two or more flanges, the bolt holes shall be correctly aligned.

clauses.title: The flanges shall be
clauses.text: 3.4 The flanges shall be plain faced over the contact surface with a tool mark finishing having a pitch of 1 0.3 mm, serrations may be spiral or concentric.

clauses.title: Rubber Gaskets – Shall
clauses.text: 4. Rubber Gaskets -  Shall  conform to IS 12820 : 1989+

clauses.title: Hardness Test
clauses.text: 5.2 Hardness Test — Not more than 210 HBS.

clauses.title: Hydrostatic Test
clauses.text: 5.3 Hydrostatic Test — shall not show leakage, sweating or any other defect, under test pressures given below and maintained for 15 s. clauses.text: 6. Sizes  Nominal Diameter of  the casting —  80, 100, 125, 150, 200, 250, 300, 350, 400, 450, 500, 600, 700,750, 800, 900,1 000, 1 050, 1 100, 1 200 and 1 500. clauses.title: Tolerances on Thickness
clauses.text: 7.1 Tolerances on Thickness —Tolerances on wall thickness and flange thickness of fittings are limited as follows : Dimensions Tolerances mm Wall thickness -(2+0.05 e) Flange thickness (3+0.05b) Where e  = standard thickness of the wall in millimetres, and b = standard thickness of the flanges in millimetres. Note — No limit for the plus tolerances is specified.

clauses.title: The coating material shall
clauses.text: 8.1 The coating material shall set rapidly with good adherence and shall not scale off.

clauses.title: Where the coating material
clauses.text: 8.2 Where the coating material has a tar or similar base, it shall be smooth and tenacious and hard enough not to flow when exposed to a temperature of 65°C but not so brittle at a temperature of 0°C as to chip off when scribed with a penknife. ±
